anchors.quote: مهم من کانتریبیوشنه اوکی ۸۵۰ تا داره بعدی خوبه

quote_en: What matters to me is the contributions; OK, there are 850; next, good.

anchors.quote: مهم من کانتریبیوشنه اوکی ۸۵۰ تا داره بعدی خوبه
اپن سورس ۵صد و ۵۰۰ تا پلاس استار گرفته آره گیتابت خوب بود

claim_en: For the Android CV (CV#10), a GitHub with 850 contributions and an open-source project with over 500 stars counts as good with the hiring manager.
quote_en: What matters to me is the contributions; OK, there are 850; good. / Open source with 500-plus stars; yes, your GitHub was good.

anchors.quote: این دش دش ایآیه
آره آره دابل دشه فقط ایآی میذاره
همه می‌دونین ایآی نوشته

claim_en: For the Android CV (CV#10), the hiring manager reads a double dash (an em-dash) as something only AI puts in, a sign that AI wrote the text.
quote_en: This dash is an AI dash. / Yes, yes, it is a double dash; only AI puts it. / Everyone knows AI wrote it.

anchors.quote: بچه‌ها اسکل شرکتو بگید

quote_en: Friends, say the scale of the company.

anchors.quote: اول از همه اینکه بچه‌ها اینا رو سعی کنید که اکشن وربا این جمله اول متفاوت باشه

claim_en: Start bullet points with action verbs, and vary the first word of each.
quote_en: First of all, friends, try to make these action verbs, the first word of each sentence, different.

anchors.quote: اگرم با ایندیپندنت آوردی بالا به نظرم نگو اینجا این مزیت نیست
من کسی می‌خوام که تو تیم بیاد کار کنه با خیلی مهمه یکی از مهم‌ترین فیچرا که ما می‌خوایم کسی رو استخدام می‌کنیم بتونه با تیم ما آداپت بشه

claim_en: Do not present work as done alone: it is not an advantage, because the hiring manager wants someone who works in a team, and adapting to the team is one of the most important things looked for.
quote_en: Even if you brought it up independently, I think do not say so here; it is not an advantage. / I want someone who comes and works in the team; it is very important; one of the most important features when we hire someone is that they can adapt to our team.

anchors.quote: کسی که تنهایی کار کرده یا اون قبلیه بود یکی فریلنس کار کرده بود و اینا اینا مشکلاتی دارن که تجربه کار با تیم ندارن پس ممکنه باهاشون چالش داشته باشیم
اون یکی رو انتخاب می‌کنم که تجربه کار تیمی بهتر داشته باشه

claim_en: Candidates who worked alone or as freelancers may lack team experience and bring challenges; between two final candidates, the hiring manager chooses the one with better teamwork experience.
quote_en: Someone who has worked alone, or the previous one who worked freelance, has the problem of no experience working with a team, so we might have challenges with them. / I choose the one who has better teamwork experience.

anchors.quote: نه دعوتم می‌کنم باز دوباره ببینیم بچه‌ها همتون اینفرال جا انداختیدا
اینفرال لازمه این یه چیز خوب نیست باید داشته باشی

claim_en: For the four-year backend CV (CV#11), the hiring manager invites the candidate despite no infrastructure, while saying infrastructure is necessary.
quote_en: No, I will invite them anyway; again, friends, you have all left out infrastructure. / Infrastructure is necessary; this is not a good thing; you must have it.

anchors.quote: این چرا فارسیه اینجا ۱۰ پلسه اینو لطفا انگلیسیش کن
اینا رو حتماً انگلیسی کن

claim_en: For the senior PHP CV (CV#12), text left in Persian should be put into English.
quote_en: Why is this in Persian here? Ten plus; please put this in English. / Definitely put these in English.

anchors.quote: چند بار پی اچ پی رو تو رزومت گفتی چهار بار گفتی همش همون اول چهار بار گفتی رزومت انقدر تکرارش نکن دیگه یه جا نوشتی اوکیه

claim_en: Do not repeat the same technology many times: the senior PHP CV (CV#12) names PHP four times near the top, and once is enough.
quote_en: How many times did you say PHP in your CV? Four times, all at the start; do not repeat it so much; writing it in one place is OK.

anchors.quote: بچه‌ها جاوا اسکریپت با تایپ اسکریپت جاوا اسکریپت خالی دیگه کسی استفاده نمی‌کنه سال‌هاست

quote_en: Friends, JavaScript with TypeScript; nobody uses plain JavaScript any more, for years.

anchors.quote: ریاکت ریاکت جی اس بیسیک چرا بیسیک ویو بیسیک
اون بیسیکه رو دوست نداشتم

claim_en: For the ten-year PHP CV (CV#12), the hiring manager did not like skills labelled basic, such as React basic and Vue basic.
quote_en: React, React.js basic; why basic? Vue basic. / I did not like that basic.

anchors.quote: من ریجکتش می‌کنم به خاطر اینکه ترافرم نداره ایشم بیسیکه به عنوان یه بک ان انجینر با ۱۰ سال سابق قطعاً انتظارش و دارم که داشته باشه

claim_en: Rejects a backend CV without infrastructure skills.
quote_en: I reject it because there is no Terraform, and that is basic for a backend engineer with 10 years of experience; I definitely expect them to have it.

anchors.quote: تو بخش زبانش گفته انگلیش اینترمیت
ولی الان این به من میگه که این آدم نمی‌تونه اصلاً دیگه واسه من انگلیسی درستی صحبت کنه با تیم من اصلاً اگه همه چیشم اوکی بود اینجا رد میشد

claim_en: A language section saying English intermediate tells the hiring manager the candidate cannot speak proper English with the team: even with everything else OK, the CV is rejected on this.
quote_en: In the language section it says English intermediate. / But now this tells me this person cannot speak proper English with my team at all; even if everything else were OK, it would be rejected here.

anchors.quote: اگه فقط انگلیشه توصیه می‌کنم بچه‌ها بخش زبانو کلاً حلش کنید و این به جای اینکه کمک کنه ضررم زد بهت

quote_en: If it is only English, I recommend, friends, that you remove the language section entirely; instead of helping, it hurt you.

anchors.quote: آره آره حتماً د تاشو با هم می‌نویسن

claim_en: Asked about JavaScript and TypeScript, the hiring manager says to write the two together.
quote_en: Yes, yes, definitely write the two together.

anchors.quote: کانتریبیوشن تقریباً خالیه من توصیه می‌کنم گیتابتو برداری

quote_en: The contributions are almost empty; I recommend you remove your GitHub.

anchors.quote: من دعوتش می‌کنم برای مصاحبه پراجکت به خاطر اینکه دایورسی سیتیش تو اسکیلا و قسمتهای مختلف زیاد بود
تو ۳ سال نشون داد که آدمیه که علاقه‌منده رفته یاد گرفته فقط به اون د تا تکنولوژی که بلد بوده گیر نبوده رفته بیشتر یاد گرفته

claim_en: The hiring manager invites the three-year frontend candidate (CV#13) because the CV shows a range of skills: in three years the candidate kept learning beyond the two core technologies, even backend.
quote_en: I invite them to an interview because of the high diversity in skills and different areas. / In 3 years they showed they are someone interested, who went and learned, was not stuck on the two technologies they knew, and learned more.

anchors.quote: بلند مدت توصیه می‌کنم برو سمت سافتور انجینر

quote_en: Long term I recommend you move toward software engineer.
